name: com.allratestoday/central-bank-mcp
title: Central Bank Rates (AllRatesToday)
description: Official central-bank & tax-authority exchange rates from 100+ institutions (ECB, Fed, BOJ, HMRC). Works with no API key.

environmentVariables.name: ALLRATES_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Without it the server runs keyless: the latest published table of any source plus the source catalogue. A free key (https://allratestoday.com/register) unlocks historical dates, time series, cross-bank comparison and publication calendars.
